( a ) paṭipucchā 1 , see sv; ( b ) paṭipucchitvā, Vin III 248, 22 (bhagavantaṃ ~itvā mama āroceyyāthā ti); M I 27, 33 foll. (aho vata mam eva satthā ~itvā ~itvā bhikkhūnaṃ dhammaṃ deseyya; Ps I 144, 32 : punappunaṃ pucchitvā); Ja V 262, 21´ (tesaṃ vacanaṃ anādiyitvā Jīvakaṃ ~itvā); — neg. a(p)paṭipucchitvā, Sp 1094, 15 (appaṭivekkhitvā ti appaṭipucchitvā); Ps II 361, 27 ; Mp II 380, 14 ; IV 186, 15 ; — fpp paṭipucchitabba , mfn. and n. impers. , M I 94, 9 (api ca aham eva tattha ~o); 111, 11 (taṃ bhagavantaṃ atisitvā amhe etaṃ atthaṃ ~aṃ maññetha); 319, 19 (tathāgato va uttariṃ ~o); Ps I 144, 33 (ayaṃ pi bhikkhu … bhagavatā attānaṃ ~aṃ icchati).

[paṭi + puggala; BHS pratipudgala, pratipuṃgala], a person equal to another, a counterpart, a peer; a rival; an adversary; Vin I 8, 22* (sadevakasmiṃ lokasmiṃ natthi me ~o) ≠ It 123, 20* ≠ Sn 544; Ps I 144, 16 foll. (~o ti codako); — appaṭipuggala , mfn. , 1. without a peer; unrivalled, unequalled; Vin I 38, 29* (yo dhīro sabbadhī danto buddho ~o); D II 157, 4* (satthā loke ~o); S I 134, 1* (atthi sakyakule jāto buddho ~o) = Thī 185; A I 22, 24 (adutiyo asahāyo appaṭimo appaṭisamo appaṭibhāgo ~o asamo); Vv 63:21 (ahaṃ pi daṭṭhuṃ gacchissaṃ jinaṃ ~aṃ); Ap 250, 14 (Siddhattho tassa vyākāsi loke ~o); Mil 239, 12 (~o buddho ti); Vism 207, 16 (sīlaguṇenāpi asamo asamasamo appaṭimo appaṭibhāgo ~o); Mp I 116, 15 (~-ttā); — 2. who is not an equal; who is not similar; M I 27, 27 (āpattiṃ ca vata āpanno assaṃ sappaṭipuggalo maṃ codeyya no ~o ti; Ps I 144, 23 : ettha ayutto paṭipuggalo ~o, imehi āpattādīhi asadisattā paṭisattu paṭimallo codako bhavituṃ ayutto ti vuttaṃ hoti); — sappaṭipuggala , mfn. , who is an equal, who is similar; M I 27, 26 (Ps I 144, 15 foll.: ~o ti samāno puggalo, samāno ti sāpattiko paṭipuggalo ti codako … api ca jāti-ādīhi pi samāno puggalo ~o).
